answer_1.quote: ExpandR first prompts the LLM to generate semantically enriched query expansions, which enhance query representations and improve the retriever's ability to rank relevant documents.
answer_1.outputs: Generated query expansions (textual augmentations of the original query)

answer_2.quote: We compare three variants: the full model (ExpandR), w/o Retriever Reward, and w/o Self-Reward. ... ExpandR w/o Retriever Reward produces expansions most aligned with LLM-generated answers, yielding the highest BLEU score.

answer_3.quote: Specifically, GPT-4o is prompted to assign faithfulness scores ranging from 1 to 5 to each expansion, measuring how well it reflects both the original query and its ground-truth document.
methods: LLM-as-judge protocol with prompted faithfulness scoring
